fields.name: amount
fields.comment: How much of the meter; its configured reservation when absent. Needs meter.

fields.comment: The meter; every meter with a configured reservation when absent.

fields.name: fits
fields.comment: Whether the reservation fits now.

fields.name: scopes
fields.comment: The enclosing scopes the answer read, innermost first, each with the values of it the answer turns on: a move of one can change it.

fields.name: until
fields.comment: When it does not fit: the start of the next UTC day, when the daily meters starting again make it fit with nothing else changing; null when only a change can make it fit, and when it fits.

fields.name: hears
fields.comment: The values of the scope the answer turns on, as a reference hears them: a JSON pointer into the scope as a read returns it (/behaviors/Budget/meters/<meter>/remaining, /behaviors/Links/targets/<link>), and, for a number, the value it changes at when it crosses it. The meter's remaining, which the reservation fits while it is at or above the number; where a daily meter keeps it out now, the scope's reserved and limit; and the link to the scope's own scope.

fields.name: used

operationSets.name: AccountActions
operationSets.comment:
An account's budget and status operations (D104), for any signed-in caller:
the core checks accounts.limits on a limit's change and accounts.observe on
a provider's usage.

operations.name: budgetReserve
operations.comment: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

docs.title: Account budget: reserve
docs.description: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetCheckReserve
operations.comment: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

docs.title: Account budget: check reserve
docs.description: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetRecordUsage
operations.comment: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. The part of it the instance's own reservation covers is released, here and in every enclosing scope, and the usage counts in each of them. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

docs.title: Account budget: record usage
docs.description: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. The part of it the instance's own reservation covers is released, here and in every enclosing scope, and the usage counts in each of them. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetSettle
operations.comment: Releases the instance's own reservation of one meter, or of every meter, here and in every enclosing scope.

docs.title: Account budget: settle
docs.description: Releases the instance's own reservation of one meter, or of every meter, here and in every enclosing scope.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetSetLimit
operations.comment: Sets a meter's limit on the instance, raising or lowering it; through limitField when the meter has one. Needs limitPermission, and is refused when the config names none, and below what the instance has used and reserved.

docs.title: Account budget: set limit
docs.description: Sets a meter's limit on the instance, raising or lowering it; through limitField when the meter has one. Needs limitPermission, and is refused when the config names none, and below what the instance has used and reserved.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetReserveFor
operations.comment: Holds an amount of a meter for an instance whose scope link points here, as that instance's reserve does, and passes it on up this instance's own scope. Refused when the amount does not fit, when that instance does not draw the meter from here, and beyond what it has reserved and this instance does not hold for it yet.

docs.title: Account budget: reserve for
docs.description: Holds an amount of a meter for an instance whose scope link points here, as that instance's reserve does, and passes it on up this instance's own scope. Refused when the amount does not fit, when that instance does not draw the meter from here, and beyond what it has reserved and this instance does not hold for it yet.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetSettleFor
operations.comment: Releases up to an amount of what this instance holds of a meter for another, never more than that one no longer holds itself, and passes the release on up this instance's own scope.

docs.title: Account budget: settle for
docs.description: Releases up to an amount of what this instance holds of a meter for another, never more than that one no longer holds itself, and passes the release on up this instance's own scope.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetRecordUsageFor
operations.comment: Counts usage of a meter by an instance whose scope link points here, releases the part of what this instance holds for it that its own reservation covered, never more than that one no longer holds, and passes both on up this instance's own scope. Never refused for the amount.

docs.title: Account budget: record usage for
docs.description: Counts usage of a meter by an instance whose scope link points here, releases the part of what this instance holds for it that its own reservation covered, never more than that one no longer holds, and passes both on up this instance's own scope. Never refused for the amount.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: budgetObserve
operations.comment: Records the usage of a meter a provider reports, in place of what the meter counts until resetsAt (until the meter's next reset without it, and until the next observe for a meter with no reset): the meter's used is the figure given, usage recorded after it adds to it, and limit, when given, is the meter's limit while it holds. Nothing passes up to an enclosing scope. Needs observePermission. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

docs.title: Account budget: observe
docs.description: Records the usage of a meter a provider reports, in place of what the meter counts until resetsAt (until the meter's next reset without it, and until the next observe for a meter with no reset): the meter's used is the figure given, usage recorded after it adds to it, and limit, when given, is the meter's limit while it holds. Nothing passes up to an enclosing scope. Needs observePermission. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operations.name: statusTransition
operations.comment: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

docs.title: Account status: transition
docs.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Account row the operation runs on.

operationSets.name: JobActions
operationSets.comment:
A job's lease, retries and status operations (D104), for any signed-in
caller: the core decides who holds a job, whose writes its token fences
and when it may run again.

operations.name: leaseAcquire
operations.comment: Takes the lease for the caller and returns its fencing token. Refused while a lease is active, the caller's own included (heartbeat renews it), without acquirePermission when the config names one, and once the instance has had maxExpiries expiries. Over a lease that expired, it applies that expiry first.

docs.title: Job lease: acquire
docs.description: Takes the lease for the caller and returns its fencing token. Refused while a lease is active, the caller's own included (heartbeat renews it), without acquirePermission when the config names one, and once the instance has had maxExpiries expiries. Over a lease that expired, it applies that expiry first.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseHeartbeat
operations.comment: Renews the lease, never past its longest hold, acknowledges the directives acknowledge names, and returns the directives sent under it that are not acknowledged. Only the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, while the lease is active: an expired lease cannot be renewed.

docs.title: Job lease: heartbeat
docs.description: Renews the lease, never past its longest hold, acknowledges the directives acknowledge names, and returns the directives sent under it that are not acknowledged. Only the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, while the lease is active: an expired lease cannot be renewed.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseRelease
operations.comment: Ends an active lease: the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, or a principal with overridePermission, who need not. The token advances, so the directives sent under the lease are not delivered again, and onExpiry moves the status when it is still one of its from states. With abandon, the holder gives the work up as failed: the release counts as an expiry, and escalate applies at the one that reaches maxExpiries.

docs.title: Job lease: release
docs.description: Ends an active lease: the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition, or a principal with overridePermission, who need not. The token advances, so the directives sent under the lease are not delivered again, and onExpiry moves the status when it is still one of its from states. With abandon, the holder gives the work up as failed: the release counts as an expiry, and escalate applies at the one that reaches maxExpiries.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseExpire
operations.comment: Applies the expiry of a lease past its expiry time or its longest hold: the holder is cleared, the token advances, the expiry is counted unless the instance is in a terminal state of its Workflow, and onExpiry or escalate moves the status. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; on any other instance it changes nothing. With holder, a principal with overridePermission expires that holder's lease at once, active or not, unless notRenewedAfter spares it. The engine's runner calls it on every lapsed lease, every sweepMs.

docs.title: Job lease: expire
docs.description: Applies the expiry of a lease past its expiry time or its longest hold: the holder is cleared, the token advances, the expiry is counted unless the instance is in a terminal state of its Workflow, and onExpiry or escalate moves the status. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; on any other instance it changes nothing. With holder, a principal with overridePermission expires that holder's lease at once, active or not, unless notRenewedAfter spares it. The engine's runner calls it on every lapsed lease, every sweepMs.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseDirect
operations.comment: Sends the holder of the active lease a directive, which its heartbeats deliver until it acknowledges it. With dedupeKey, a directive already sent under the lease with the key is not sent again. A principal needs directPermission, or overridePermission when that is absent, and is refused when the config names neither; another behavior of the type sends one with call(), as the principal it runs for, without either.

docs.title: Job lease: direct
docs.description: Sends the holder of the active lease a directive, which its heartbeats deliver until it acknowledges it. With dedupeKey, a directive already sent under the lease with the key is not sent again. A principal needs directPermission, or overridePermission when that is absent, and is refused when the config names neither; another behavior of the type sends one with call(), as the principal it runs for, without either.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseAcknowledge
operations.comment: Marks directives of the lease as handled, so heartbeats stop delivering them. Only the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition.

docs.title: Job lease: acknowledge
docs.description: Marks directives of the lease as handled, so heartbeats stop delivering them. Only the holder, presenting the current token as Lease's precondition.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: leaseExpireHolder
operations.comment: Expires every lease one principal holds on the schema's instances, active or not, as expire with that holder does on each: for a principal that is gone. With notRenewedAfter, an active lease renewed after that time is spared. Needs overridePermission; refused when the config names none.

docs.title: Job lease: expire holder
docs.description: Expires every lease one principal holds on the schema's instances, active or not, as expire with that holder does on each: for a principal that is gone. With notRenewedAfter, an active lease renewed after that time is spared. Needs overridePermission; refused when the config names none.

operations.name: leaseResetExpiries
operations.comment: Sets the instance's count of expiries back to 0, so a lease can be acquired again after maxExpiries. Needs overridePermission; refused when the config names none.

docs.title: Job lease: reset expiries
docs.description: Sets the instance's count of expiries back to 0, so a lease can be acquired again after maxExpiries. Needs overridePermission; refused when the config names none.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Job row the operation runs on.

operations.name: retriesRecordAttempt
operations.comment: Records an attempt: a success without failure, or a failure of one of the config's classes, counted against its caps, and returns the class's hint. Decides whether its result is kept, and writes a kept result to resultField. Exhausts the instance at a terminal class, a failure past a cap or a stuck signature, moving its status to exhaustedState from the from states. Refused once the instance is exhausted, and without the config's permission.

operations.comment: Applies the miss of an instance past its deadline and not missed yet: sets missed, moves the status with onMissed when it is one of its from states, and expires the principal's leases on the releaseLeases schemas that were not renewed after its last beat, recording which in released. workers.name: JobDeadlines
workers.comment:
Runs Job's deadlines as they fall due (D103, D104): a lease's expiry and
the end of a backoff. The worker fixture-agents-api-job-deadlines.

workers.name: SessionPresence
workers.comment:
Runs each session's miss as it falls due (D104): the worker
fixture-agents-api-session-presence. A miss expires the leases the device
holds on jobs through Lease's expire, which needs Job's Lease
overridePermission, so the worker holds it.
